description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Holy 20% (15s)], grants [Buff Holy 20% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fusoya], [Apex Double Black Magic Ability Tracker] and [Apex Double Black Magic Level]

description.name: Buff Holy 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fusoya
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Double Black Magic (0~2), removed after using Apex Double Black Magic two times

description.name: Apex Double Black Magic Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Double Black Magic level by 1 after using 7 White Magic or Black Magic abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fusoya]

description.name: Apex Double Black Magic Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Double Black Magic level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Fusoya]
